title: Corrected lower-degree lifts for vanishing classes
statement: In the filtered colimit-of-sites setting of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites] with compatible abelian sheaves Fs and canonical degree n+1 diagram D and cocone c, and pullback maps natural in sheaves and commuting with connecting maps [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback], there exists a compatible auxiliary system Rs with its degree n diagram E, canonical cocone d, and natural transformation delta:E→D. For each t and x in D(t) whose c-leg image is zero, there is an arrow b:t→tprime and z in E(tprime) such that d(z)=0 and delta(z)=D(b)(x). The systems, colimit sheaves [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and cohomology [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] are specified with the same endpoint transports as the original diagram.

source.place: Tag 09YP, using Sites 09YN and the right-exact diagram of Tag 0739

proof.text: Apply the exact-ladder theorem in continuation form to obtain the compatible cokernel and middle systems, their canonical diagrams, the natural connecting map delta with surjective components, the zero consecutive composite, the two squares, and target exactness.

For x killed by its comparison leg, choose z with delta(z)=x. The connecting comparison square shows beta(d(z))=0. Target exactness supplies w with alpha0(w)=d(z). Apply class descent in degree n to the middle system and its canonical cocone to represent w by v at an index s.

Choose a common successor r of t and s in Under(i), with arrows f and g. Set zprime=E(f)(z)-alpha(r)(B(g)(v)). The cocone laws and alpha comparison square give d(zprime)=d(z)-alpha0(w)=0. Naturality of delta gives delta(E(f)(z))=D(f)(x), and the zero composite gives delta(alpha(r)(B(g)(v)))=0. Additivity gives delta(zprime)=D(f)(x). This algebra is proved in the private corrected_lift_of_exact_ladder helper.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09YP and 0739; explicit finite-stage subtraction chase by R2
